concept: Civic and community honor — following through on obligations to others beyond immediate self-interest
source_inspiration: original content, informed by civic-honor themes present in older Civics and Moral Education models — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A scenario involving a community, neighborhood, or civic commitment (e.g. a volunteer role, a shared responsibility) that becomes burdensome
exercise.reflection_prompt: What do we owe to commitments that affect people beyond ourselves?
exercise.practice: Adult reasons through when honoring a commitment matters most, and when renegotiating it honestly is the more honorable path

assessment.success_marker: adult distinguishes between honorably renegotiating a commitment and simply abandoning it
